Ava (Sales): Hi team — handing off PulseMed (midmarket, private deploy) to CS. Key things: target launch 2026-06-01, Okta SSO + SCIM, customer-provided dedicated pool. During pilot they hit erratic tail latency on multi-document summarization (p95 sometimes ~15-22s). They expect p95 <3s for single-shot prompts. Renewal isn't immediate but flagged as a concern if performance regresses post-launch. Contacts: sam@pulse.med (Sam, Eng), megan@pulse.med (Ops). Asks: 1) ENG perf triage 2) Support to validate SCIM+SSO flow and create ops runbook 3) CS enablement + runbook for their devs. I'll attach repro examples.

Diego (CS): I'll run the onboarding and coordinate. Owners: Diego = CS lead, Maya = perf triage, Jon = SSO+ops runbook, Ava = sales liaison. Kickoff Tue 2026-05-20 11:00 PT proposed. Ava  can you post repro snippets and any demo logs here?

Ava (Sales): pasted minimal repro below.

```bash
# repro: multi-doc summarize
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q4","input":"<doc1>...<docN>\nQ: TL;DR"}'
# notes: single doc <1k tokens p95 ~1.2s, multi-doc flows sometimes spike to 15-22s
```

Infra Bot: Created ticket PERF-5543 (PulseMed tail latency) assigned to Maya. https://redwood.internal/tickets/PERF-5543

Maya (Eng): picking up PERF-5543. Need full demo logs, model binary name, quant flags, and the exact failing prompt set. Plan: reproduce on infra mirror, capture seq-len distribution + kv cache heatmap, inspect batching. ETA initial findings 72h.

Jon (Support): I'll draft SCIM+SSO validation checklist and ops runbook (user provisioning, SAML assertions, rollback steps). Diego  ask Sam for an SP metadata file and one test user with scoped permissions.

Diego (CS): requested logs + SP metadata from Sam just now. I'll upload artifacts to shared bucket when received and send calendar invite for kickoff.

Ava (Sales): Sam replied: uploading logs and will create a test user tomorrow. Also asked about cost/dedicated sizing guidance.

Diego (CS): Next steps checklist:
- Diego: collect logs, send invite, upload artifacts (today)
- Maya: start PERF-5543 reproduction and initial triage (today)
- Jon: SCIM/SSO runbook draft (EOD)
- Ava: confirm sizing question answer + follow up with Sam

Maya (Eng): if we reproduce, quick mitigations to try: adjust batching window for large-doc flows, enable prefix caching, and test a smaller quant path. Will update ticket with findings.

Jon (Support): will include pre-launch smoke tests in runbook and contact matrix (who to page for infra vs runtime issues).

Diego (CS): thanks everyone  we'll surface progress in the weekly onboarding digest and escalate to oncall if we see production-impacting traces.
